svg.title: Native two-mirror pointing diagnostics — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: Two separated steering mirrors fold a beam through a monitoring split. One camera samples position in the outgoing beam; a lens and focal-plane camera provide the angle-sensitive branch. The actual mirrors, diagnostic split, lens and camera rays are represented. This bench is manually aligned; there is no calibrated actuator/sensor Jacobian, quadrant electronics or automatic two-axis pointing controller.
